description: Notion stores 24.999999999999996 while Stripe and Airtable hold 25. Minor-unit conversion must read 2500 everywhere, with no false divergence and no new Stripe price.
adapted_from_spec: The spec uses a verify-only request; the contract has none, so the already-applied change is requested again and must read the float back as 2500 without writing a new Stripe price.
